plugin.note: Use vampyrebane melee, Efaritay's aid, and earmuffs/Slayer helmet. Sunspear finishing special attacks produce hearts for shrine restoration.

mechanics: Venators are living vampyres; Salve amulet bonuses do not apply.
Earmuffs or a Slayer helmet reduce shriek damage. Protection prayer during the shriek causes repeated damage and prayer loss.
Venators can be killed off-task by paying the nearby aranei 30 Stymphike feathers per kill.
Superior blood-starved venators can spawn with Bigger and Badder even when killing venators off-task.

methods.label: Vampyrebane melee
methods.summary: Fight in melee using Sunspear or hallowed flail. Efaritay's aid stacks with the Slayer helmet.
steps: Use a designated vampyrebane weapon; ordinary weapons and Salve amulets do not provide their usual benefits here.
Prepare for the shriek mechanic: an active protection prayer during it causes repeated damage and prayer drain.
A Sunspear special attack that kills a venator produces a heart; sacrifice it at the Aranei shrine to restore 50% special attack energy and up to 24 prayer points.
notes: Saradomin godsword and Ancient godsword specials can heal despite doing zero damage. Burning claws can apply burn despite dealing no direct damage.

methods.label: Blisterwood stakes
methods.summary: Blisterwood stakes are a valid ranged damage source, including the Virer spawn inaccessible to melee. Ranged defence is higher than melee defence.

methods.label: Vampyrium travel and banking
methods.summary: Reach Vampyrium using Drakan's medallion and the Castle Drakan portal, then travel south to the hunting grounds.
steps: Gear at Sangvesti bank chest when available (70 Construction to build).
Use the pillar shortcut at 73 Agility; bring a pickaxe for the rubble south of it.

methods.label: Off-task feather payment
methods.summary: Pay the nearby aranei 30 Stymphike feathers per kill to fight off-task. Bigger and Badder still permits superior spawns.
